\catcode`\{=1 \catcode`\}=2
% The portability workflow's \write18 fixture (INITEX, restricted shell
% escape), run by the engine and by TeX Live's pdftex.exe, whose logs must
% agree: a restricted \write18 (re-quoted as "-var-value=TEXMFROOT" for
% cmd.exe), and a pipe whose command is in single quotes, which texmfmp.c's
% runpopen turns into double quotes on Windows (elsewhere a quotation error,
% and the pipe stays closed).
\immediate\write18{kpsewhich -var-value=TEXMFROOT}
\openin1=|"kpsewhich 'plain.tex'"
\ifeof1 \message{[pipe: closed]}\else
  \read1 to\found \closein1
  \message{[pipe: \found]}\fi
\end
